description: Finish the remaining acquisition strategy and adapter refactor by consolidating API gateway dispatch behind the provider registry, running final verification, and updating handoff notes.

userStories.title: Make API gateway dispatch registry-first
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want call_api_gateway to route any registered provider through the adapter registry before fallback handling so that provider dispatch is centralized in the gateway layer.
acceptanceCriteria: call_api_gateway(...) checks get_api_provider_registry() once and routes any supported provider through registry.get(provider).execute(request)
Add regression coverage proving a registered provider that is not named in a hardcoded branch still routes through the registry for both search and download
Gateway compatibility tests for PMC, Crossref, JStage, DOAJ, and Unpaywall still pass after the facade refactor

userStories.title: Run final acquisition adapter verification wave
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want final syntax, regression, and lint verification for the acquisition adapter scope so that the refactor is proven before handoff.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run python -m py_compile src/agents/acquisition/node.py src/agents/acquisition/api_tool.py src/agents/acquisition/crawl_tool.py src/domain/literature/acquisition_agent.py src/domain/literature/gateway/api_gateway.py src/domain/literature/gateway/base.py src/domain/literature/gateway/registry.py src/domain/literature/gateway/adapters/__init__.py src/domain/literature/gateway/adapters/*.py passes

uv run pytest -q tests/test_api_gateway_download.py tests/test_literature_unified_workflow.py tests/test_agents_acquisition.py tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_registry.py tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_pmc_adapter.py tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_crossref_adapter.py tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_jstage_adapter.py tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_doaj_adapter.py tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_unpaywall_adapter.py passes

uv run ruff check src/domain/literature/gateway/api_gateway.py src/domain/literature/gateway/adapters src/agents/acquisition src/domain/literature/acquisition_agent.py tests/test_api_gateway_download.py tests/test_literature_unified_workflow.py tests/test_agents_acquisition.py tests/domain/literature/gateway passes

userStories.title: Record acquisition adapter milestone in handoff notes
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want progress and handoff notes updated with the acquisition adapter milestone so that the remaining context and verification evidence are preserved for later work.
acceptanceCriteria: Append a progress.txt milestone entry summarizing the acquisition adapter and gateway facade work that was completed
List the exact verification commands and passing results cited in the progress update
Update lesson.md only if a debugging pattern or root cause was discovered during the refactor
userStories.notes: This Ralph PRD reflects the remaining work after the initial adapter registry and provider migrations already landed in the branch.
